usage: jbus view [-h] [--port PORT] [--since SINCE] [{usage}]

positional arguments:
  {usage}        with usage, count each route, drawer and first click the page
                 opened

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --port PORT    the one port it listens on
  --since SINCE  count from this time, the user's zone with none (default: 7
                 days ago)
